title: The Rack
description: Bottles came up green. Oddvar wants the rack found, and whatever is still in it.

fetch.title: Find the wine-rack
fetch.objective: Go down and bring back a bottle from the rack.
fetch.journal: Oddvar wants a bottle from the rack. Bottles came up green.

returned.title: Green glass
returned.journal: I brought Oddvar a bottle off the rack. He sniffed it and did not drink.
